text.en: Only under an oncologist; continue until progression or unacceptable toxicity. Dose adjustments for toxicity and interactions per label.

text.en: Interstitial lung disease; renal failure; hepatotoxicity; GI perforation; bullous skin disorders; stroke; microangiopathic haemolytic anaemia; ocular disorders; bleeding with warfarin; embryo-fetal toxicity.

text.en: Label: can cause fetal harm. Dangerous in pregnancy.

pregnancy.quote: Risk Summary Based on animal data and its mechanism of action, erlotinib can cause fetal harm when administered to a pregnant woman.

text.en: Label: breastfeeding not recommended, or choose between the drug and breastfeeding.

lactation.quote: Advise a lactating woman not to breastfeed during treatment with erlotinib tablets and for 2 weeks after the final dose.
